growth_signal.value: Supplies power to 200,000 UK households and reached $400 million in annual recurring revenue as of December 2025.

entry.idea: Fuse Energy sells cheaper household and business electricity and gas, while also building and owning its own solar and wind power to supply it.
entry.lesson: Combine being a customer-friendly reseller with owning the supply source, so you are not just squeezed by wholesale prices.
entry.name: Fuse Energy

growth.reason: It reached $400 million in annual recurring revenue and 200,000 households, described as Europe's fastest-growing energy startup.

market.reason: Almost every household and business needs energy, though Fuse currently only serves Great Britain.

tech.reason: Owning some renewable generation is a real asset, but energy retail and small-scale generation are not hard for a well-funded rival to replicate.

sources.title: Fuse Energy raises $70m backed by Balderton and Lowercarbon Capital | Sifted
Founded by former Revolut executives, Britain's Fuse Energy secures €59 million to scale energy operations | EU-Startups
Ex-Revolut execs turn Fuse into Europe's fastest-growing energy startup — TFN

entry.twist: Unlike most energy resellers, it owns real solar farms and a wind turbine, so it makes money both from supplying customers and from generating renewable power itself.
entry.who_pays: Households and businesses pay Fuse for their electricity, gas and EV charging.
entry.why_now: Rising energy bills make customers eager to switch suppliers, while cheaper renewable power lets a new entrant undercut established energy companies.
